## Summary

Implemented DS-12: Added "Add Product" button and modal form to the Products page following the Customers modal pattern. Converted products to mutable useState, added modal state/handlers, appended product-modal CSS classes, and created comprehensive tests.

## Plan Steps Completed

- **Step 1** — Updated `src/Products.js`: added `toast` import, converted `mockProducts` to `useState(mockProducts)`, added modal state/handlers, added customer-header wrapper with "Add Product" button, added modal JSX after pagination block
- **Step 2** — Updated `src/App.css`: appended `.product-modal-*` classes (overlay, modal, title, form, actions, save-btn, cancel-btn) copied from `.customer-modal-*`
- **Step 3** — Created `src/Products.test.js`: 10 tests mirroring Customers.test.js (smoke, rows, search, no-results, pagination, search-resets, button, modal open, cancel, save)
- **Step 4** — Verified: Products 10/10 ✅, Customers 10/10 ✅ (no regression), build succeeds ✅

## Files Changed

- `src/Products.js` — Added `toast` import, `useState` for product/modal state, handlers (`handleOpenModal`, `handleCloseModal`, `handleFormChange`, `handleSave`), header wrapper with button, full modal JSX
- `src/App.css` — Appended `.product-modal-overlay`, `.product-modal`, `.product-modal-title`, `.product-modal-form`, `.product-modal-actions`, `.product-modal-save-btn`, `.product-modal-cancel-btn`, `.product-modal-cancel-btn:hover` (identical to customer-modal counterparts)
- `src/Products.test.js` — New test file with 10 tests covering smoke, table rows, case-insensitive search, no-results, pagination (2 pages), search resets, button render, modal open, cancel without save, full save flow with toast verification

## Validation

- `npm test -- --watchAll=false src/Products.test.js` — 10/10 passed
- `npm test -- --watchAll=false src/Customers.test.js` — 10/10 passed (no regression)
- `npm run build` — succeeds with no errors

## Risks

- New products are in-memory only (reset on refresh) — same behavior as Customers, acceptable per spec
- `.product-modal-*` and `.customer-modal-*` CSS are identical copies — future styling changes must be duplicated (documented acceptable trade-off)
